from collections import Counter
def solve(g, noise):
    n=len(g)
    def refl(i,j): return [(i,j),(i,n-1-j),(n-1-i,j),(n-1-i,n-1-j),(j,i),(j,n-1-i),(n-1-j,i),(n-1-j,n-1-i)]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            clean=[g[a][b] for a,b in refl(i,j) if g[a][b]!=noise]
            if clean: out[i][j]=Counter(clean).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sym=all(out[i][j]==out[a][b] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for a,b in refl(i,j))
    return out, sym
def f(g):

        out,sym=solve(g,noise)

    return solve(g,None)[0]

    from collections import Counter
    g=grid; n=len(g)
    def refl(i,j): return [(i,j),(i,n-1-j),(n-1-i,j),(n-1-i,n-1-j),(j,i),(j,n-1-i),(n-1-j,i),(n-1-j,n-1-i)]
    def solve(noise):
        out=[r[:] for r in g]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                clean=[g[a][b] for a,b in refl(i,j) if g[a][b]!=noise]
                if clean: out[i][j]=Counter(clean).most_common(1)[0][0]
        sym=all(out[i][j]==out[a][b] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for a,b in refl(i,j))
        return out,sym
    def closed(c):
        return all(g[a][b]==c for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if g[i][j]==c for a,b in refl(i,j))
    good=[]
    for c in sorted(set(v for r in g for v in r)):
        if not closed(c):
            out,sym=solve(c)

    if len(good)==1: return good[0][1]
    if good:
        return min(good,key=lambda x:sum(x[1][i][j]!=g[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)))[1]
    return solve(None)[0]
